claim: A single omniseek_search call with the frozen need as the query returns text containing the claim key.
frozen_need: My dad has a large digital game library across two console platforms and a PC storefront, and he's asked me to work out what actually happens to it after he dies. I don't want the boilerplate 'licenses are non-transferable' line: I want to know what families have managed in practice, whether any platform has ever acted on a will or a death certificate, what realistically happens if we just keep using his account, and whether the answer changes by country.

args.query: My dad has a large digital game library across two console platforms and a PC storefront, and he's asked me to work out what actually happens to it after he dies. I don't want the boilerplate 'licenses are non-transferable' line: I want to know what families have managed in practice, whether any platform has ever acted on a will or a death certificate, what realistically happens if we just keep using his account, and whether the answer changes by country.

ground_truth.value: Do not notify gaming platforms of the death unless you have decided to formally close the account.

accepted_forms: 除非你已经决定正式关闭账户，否则不要通知游戏平台有人去世。

answering_doc.title: Online Gaming Accounts After Death: What Happens to Virtual Assets?

settles: if the family's goal is continued informal use of the library, do not notify the platforms: notification can trigger lock or closure and cut existing access
leaves_open: the legal effect of wills and death certificates on formal transfer
verifiable success cases of families keeping accounts
admission.note: Competing bereavement guides frame the task as closing accounts; none carries this directive sentence.
